system_recommendation.headline: Charge high-voltage battery: volume-weighted priority 0.59 over the markets with enough evidence (56% of sales volume). Prioritise: G60 EU, G60 RoW; Consider: G60 US, G70 EU, G70 US, G70 RoW; Insufficient evidence: F70 EU, F70 RoW, G60 CN, G70 CN; Not sold: F70 US, F70 CN.

scoring.survey_weakness: (rank - 1) / (attributes - 1); rank 1 = best-rated attribute of that series in that market
scoring.breadth: percentile of the feature's comment count among the series' features (all markets)

rationale.weights: Complaints weigh twice as much as requests (PM guidance: complaints and defects outrank wish-list features). Breadth rewards features many customers raise over niche ones.
rationale.market_multipliers: 1.0 = market weighted by its sales volume. Raise a market to emphasise it (e.g. a regional strategy); lower to de-emphasise.
rationale.thresholds: A cell needs at least half of the weighted evidence present to get a recommendation.
rationale.borrowing: When a model + market has fewer than 8 comments on the feature, the model's verdict over all markets is used at a discounted weight and labelled 'borrowed'. China has no customer feedback in the data and configurations differ by market, so it does not borrow by default.
